description: This file contains PHP functions that generate HTML layout and rendering logic for the Calendar module in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for different calendar views such as Day, Week, Month, and Year, as well as utilities for navigation, event listing, and UI components like mini calendars and headers.

methods.name: calendar_layout
methods.description: Generates the main layout for the calendar view, including header, sub-tabs (Events/Todos), and the selected view (list, hour). Controls rendering of day, week, month, and year views based on parameters.

methods.name: get_mini_calendar
methods.description: Creates HTML for a small mini calendar view, typically for sidebar or quick navigation.

methods.name: get_cal_header_tab
methods.description: Generates the header section of the calendar with view buttons (Day, Week, Month, Year), navigation (previous/next), and links for settings and quick view toggles.

methods.name: get_cal_header_data
methods.description: Displays summary information about total events, todos, pending items, and provides controls for adding new events and filtering views.

methods.name: getEventListView
methods.description: Constructs and outputs the HTML for the list view of calendar events within the selected date range, according to current view (day/week/month/year).

methods.name: getTodosListView
methods.description: Constructs and outputs the HTML for the list view of todos within the specified date range.

methods.name: getDayViewLayout
methods.description: Renders the detailed Day view with hourly time slots and activities/events scheduled within each hour.

methods.name: getWeekViewLayout
methods.description: Creates the Week view layout with days as columns and hours as rows, displaying scheduled events in appropriate cells.

methods.name: getMonthViewLayout
methods.description: Generates the Month grid view, with each cell representing a day, including links to create/edit events directly.

methods.name: getYearViewLayout
methods.description: Renders the Year view in a grid, divided into quarters/rows, with navigable links for each month.

methods.name: getdayEventLayer
methods.description: Creates HTML layers for events on the Day view, including event details, owner, time, and action buttons.

methods.name: getweekEventLayer
methods.description: Creates event HTML layers for the Week view, including similar details and permissions for each event.

methods.name: getmonthEventLayer
methods.description: Creates HTML snippets for events displayed in individual Day cells within the Month view.
